datasets.description: Ferry stops with coordinates; join trips.stop to stops.name.
caveats: Coordinates have not been checked at jetty precision.
Zone 3 coverage is missing.

datasets.description: Scheduled ferry route identities, zones and stop lists.
caveats: A route record is not a service calendar.

datasets.description: Ordered ferry stop-times: one row per route_id, trip and order. Not one row per whole trip.
caveats: Service weekdays and exceptions are unknown.
Preserve direction, trip identity and waiting time.
Times use Indian/Maldives (UTC+5).

datasets.description: Directed ferry stop-pair summaries.
caveats: Shortest duration and first/last departures do not reconstruct a full timetable.

datasets.description: Route stop sequences without timed service.
caveats: Exclude the ERROR row.
Do not silently mix untimed links into a scheduled baseline.

datasets.description: Bus route-stop sequences and coordinates.
caveats: Stops repeat across routes; stop codes need namespace checks.

datasets.description: Bus route metadata and some fares/frequencies.
caveats: Daily trip counts are incomplete.

datasets.description: Extracted bus stop departures.
caveats: Only a partial evening snapshot, not an all-day timetable.

datasets.description: Supplementary island-pair sea connectivity and coordinates.
caveats: No scheduled departure times or journey durations.

datasets.description: Long-format yearbook observations, including Census 2022 island population in table 3.3.
caveats: Read source_table as text.
Resident and registered populations differ.
Do not double-count totals, Male wards or non-admin-island categories.
datasets.source: MBS yearbooks via Team Kandu; source_url retained per row

datasets.description: Airline destination catalogue.
caveats: Filter domestic destinations.
Destination presence does not establish airport-pair schedules.

datasets.description: Named island polygons with adm2_pcode and atoll names.
caveats: Includes inhabited and other islands; reconcile census identifiers.
Other sources' ADM2 levels are not equivalent.
datasets.source: OCHA COD-AB; valid_on fields describe reference date

datasets.description: Parsed health registry identities, levels and inferred islands.
caveats: Check operational status and location_source.
No verified building coordinates or current clinical capacity.

datasets.description: Ministry school directory identities and island/address information.
caveats: Coordinates and current grade provision need verification.

datasets.description: Airport and seaplane-base locations.
caveats: Filter iso_country=MV if needed.
Airport presence does not prove scheduled service.

datasets.description: Anonymised historical airport traffic records; dictionary in adjacent Metadata.csv.
caveats: Does not establish domestic airport-pair schedules.
Carrier and route codes are anonymised.

datasets.description: Bus/ferry passenger demonstrations in a multi-sheet workbook.
caveats: PASSENGER FIGURES ARE SYNTHETIC. Route names/codes are real.
Read the workbook README before analysis.

datasets.description: Greater Male ride requests, coordinates, statuses and supplied time/distance.
caveats: Status meanings and whether travel times are estimates require verification.
Do not publish individual ride coordinates.

datasets.description: One day of historical GPS telemetry; 31 daily CSVs exist locally.
caveats: Boat/vehicle classification and supplied speed units are unverified.
Device timestamps can be stale; handle GPS errors and duplicates.
Device identifiers are redacted by sample tools.

datasets.description: Published hospital-access model summary, not a facility directory.
caveats: Car-based model omits ferry schedules.
Missing areas are not necessarily observed zero access.
Population denominator differs from census.
